title: Australian For AIs — Evaluation Prediction Record
description: Schema for a single model prediction record used in evaluation.

example_id.description: Must match the 'id' field of an existing benchmark example.

predicted_literal.description: Model's literal interpretation of the utterance.

predicted_pragmatic.description: Model's pragmatic interpretation of the utterance. 'insufficient_context' is accepted when the benchmark example explicitly declares that sentinel as its primary interpretation.

predicted_ambiguity.description: Model's judgement of whether the utterance is ambiguous.

model_confidence.description: Model's reported confidence in its primary pragmatic prediction (0.0–1.0).

model_id.description: Identifier for the model that produced this prediction.

notes.description: Optional free-text notes about this prediction.
